purpose: Prevent cross-asset, cross-market, cross-timeframe, or cross-reading data contamination in the user portal.
rules: No decision endpoint is called before the required context is complete.
Every decision request carries symbol, timeframe, and analysis_mode.
Returned symbol and timeframe are validated when present.
A mismatched response is blocked and never rendered as the selected asset decision.
Changing market, symbol, timeframe, or analysis_mode creates a new decision session.
Display mode may change presentation but may not change scientific values.
Missing values are shown as unavailable and are never fabricated.
